title: 交通与公共生活词汇
goal: 掌握交通公共服务词汇并对应服务信息

points.label: 选用交通与公共服务词汇
保留服务范围与功能的原意

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 课程内容所依据的考试大纲

body.p: 介绍公共交通的短文常讲三类内容：出行方式、服务设施和生活变化。翻译时要译出服务的范围和作用。例如 The bus connects the village to the station. 说明公交车连接村庄和车站。

cards.title: 词汇表：出行方式
rows: The train stops at the station.
The subway runs beneath the city.
She rides a bicycle to work.
A taxi waits outside the station.

cards.title: 词汇表：服务设施
rows: The train stops at the platform.
The bus stop is near the school.
The exit leads to the street.
Use the crossing near the station.
A bicycle lane follows the road.
The bus network serves several towns.

cards.title: 词汇表：生活变化
rows: The new stop is convenient for residents.
adj. 可到达的；便于使用的
The station is accessible by bus.
The route extends to the hospital.
The bus stops at nearby schools.
A regular service links the towns.
n. 到达或使用的途径
The route improves access to shops.

body.p: 中文：一条新的公交线路连接镇中心和附近三个村庄。车辆经过学校和医院，居民可以在车站换乘火车。车站设有时刻表和候车亭，为乘客提供出行信息。新线路使村民前往镇中心更加方便，也改善了他们使用公共服务的条件。

body.box: A new bus route connects the town center with three nearby villages. It passes a school and a hospital, and residents can transfer to trains at the station. The station has a timetable and a shelter and provides travel information for passengers. The route makes travel to the town center more convenient for villagers and improves their access to public services.

body.p: three nearby villages 说明服务范围。transfer to trains 表示换乘火车。时刻表和候车亭是车站的设施。

groups.fill: A town has improved local travel. A new b{us} ro{ute} connects the village with the railway sta{tion}. Passengers can check the time{table} before they leave home. At the bus st{op}, a she{lter} protects waiting passengers from rain. The service also passes a school and a hospital. It is conve{nient} for residents who do not drive. They can tran{sfer} to a tr{ain} at the station and re{ach} other towns. The route runs regularly throughout the day and helps people use public services.
notes: bus：公交车连接村庄与车站。

groups.text: 中文：一条渡船线路连接河两岸的两个村庄。村民可以携带自行车上船，码头附近设有公交站。渡船每天早晚运行，方便村民往返。公交车从码头开往镇中心，乘客可以在那里到达市场和医院。此线路为居民提供了出行选择。

options: Two villages on the same bank
The landing and the town center
items.why: 原文说渡船连接河两岸的两个村庄，对应第一项。码头到镇中心是公交车的线路。

items.stem: Which statement describes the bicycle service?
options: Bicycles must stay at the landing.
Bicycles may be taken onto the ferry.
Bicycles must be ridden across the river.
Bicycles may be taken only to the bus stop.
items.why: 原文允许携带自行车上船，对应第二项。

items.stem: What facility is near the ferry landing?
items.why: 原文说码头附近设有公交站，对应第三项。市场和医院在镇中心。

options: Every hour from morning to evening
items.why: 原文说渡船每天早晚运行，对应第四项。第二项只说了早上。

items.stem: Where does the bus from the landing go?
items.why: 原文说公交车从码头开往镇中心，对应第一项。

groups.fill: Residents have several ways to travel. A rai{lway} connects the town with the city, and a tr{ain} stops at the local sta{tion}. A b{us} takes passengers from nearby villages to that station. Its ro{ute} also passes the hospital. A time{table} shows when each service leaves. People can tran{sfer} between the bus and train there. A covered she{lter} gives passengers a place to wait. The transport net{work} makes it easier to re{ach} workplaces and public services without driving a car.

groups.text: 中文：一条公共汽车线路连接镇中心和东边的两个村庄，沿途经过一所学校和一家医院。村民可在镇中心换乘火车。车站提供时刻表，候车亭为乘客遮雨。线路开通后，村民前往医院更方便，前往学校的步行距离也缩短了。

items.stem: Which places does the bus route connect?
options: The school and the hospital only
The town center and two eastern villages
The school and two western villages
Two eastern villages and the railway
items.why: 原文说线路连接镇中心和东边两个村庄，对应第二项。

items.stem: Where can villagers transfer to a train?
items.why: 原文说明村民可在镇中心换乘火车，对应第三项。
原文说车站提供时刻表，对应第四项。遮雨的是候车亭。

items.stem: What is the function of the shelter?
options: It gives waiting passengers cover from rain.
It displays the timetable for passengers.
It connects the villages with the hospital.
It carries passengers to the town center.
items.why: 原文说候车亭为乘客遮雨，对应第一项。

items.stem: What change is mentioned after the route opened?
options: The walk to the hospital became shorter.
The walk to school became shorter.
The walk to school became longer.
The bus stopped going to the school.
items.why: 原文说前往学校的步行距离缩短，对应第二项。去医院是更方便，原文没有说步行距离缩短。
